page.layout: Running head at top, with page number 22 at the top left. Two parallel columns: left, numbered definitions I.-6.; right, numbered diagram entries I.-6. with braces. Below them, full-width running text. Then two full-width diagrams (RES, Corporalium). Catchword "Anima-" at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: I. Genus summū ab Indivi-duis remotissimum.
Sed profer exemplum aliquod ad Iuris ci-vilis, & vitæ communis usum pertinens. Ex-emplum ex libris nostris hoc esto.

page.notes: Long s rendered as s throughout. Macrons kept as printed on "summū", "Inanimatū", "Corpusanimatū". Hyphens kept at the printed line breaks ("Indivi-duis", "ci-vilis", "Ex-emplum", "pro-xima"). The right-column entries are brace diagrams, so each box is one line. The numbering "3·" is printed with a raised dot and is kept as printed.
